newsitem.title: FINLAND: Record smuggled alcohol haul in Finland - paper.
newsitem.headline: Record smuggled alcohol haul in Finland - paper.

text.p: Customs officials in Helsinki port have made the country's largest-ever seizure of smuggled alcohol, in shipments disguised as antifreeze, daily Helsingin Sanomat said on Friday.

Customs have blocked a total of 13 containers holding 200,000 litres (44,500 imperial gallons) of 96 percent-proof alcohol over several weeks and arrested an unnamed Finn who came to claim the shipment, the newspaper said.

The paper said the single haul was double the total amount of alcohol confiscated by customs for last year as a whole: diluted to normal strength, it would have been the equivalent of a million bottles of vodka.

The shipment was ordered by a Swedish-Estonian company, and the shipping documents showed it originated in China and was destined for Russia, but officials suspect some was meant to be sold in Finland, the paper said.
Some of the alcohol was dyed blue with a harmless dye, and some was made to look like denatured alcohol by colouring it yellow with salt, the paper said.
